answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 60368 Country: India Title: About Fasting for ladies who are on breastfeeding to there baby Question: My question is that can a lady skip the Roza because of breast feeding as the baby keeps the mummy busy hour by hour and because of Roza she can't have any kind of intake of food or water and because of this she feels very weak. Answer ID: 60368 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 996/796/D=09/1436) In case a woman breastfeeding her baby fears her or baby’s life then in such case she should skip the fast and make its qaza later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
